subject: English
question_text: Suppose, you are Anika. Now write a dialogue between
stimulus: you and a library assistant in connection with having library card. 10
guide_solution: Dialogue writing A dialogue between myself and a library assistant in connection with having a library card : Myself : Hello. How're you? Library Assistant : I am fine, thank you. What can I do for you? Myself : I need to have a library card. Library Assistant : That is very good. What class do you read in? Myself : I read in class ten. Library Assistant : Okay. Do you want a membership for a full year or just for six months? Myself : I want a membership for the whole year. Library Assistant : Okay. You will have to fill up this form and give this to me with two passport size photographs. You will also need a recommendation letter from your class teacher and a signature from your Head master. Myself : Is there anything more? Library Assistant : No, nothing else. That's all. Myself : Okay. I will fill up this form and bring it to you tomorrow. Thank you very much for your help. Library Assistant : You are welcome. See you tomorrow.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 92 — Bangladesh Mohila Samitee Girls' High School, Chittagong
